final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need 1 approving review before they can be merged. The rule also applies to administrators. This was observed in the live repository settings on 2026-11-18.
final_draft.note: The approved answer and the live setting give different numbers, so please check this before sending. The approved answer (answer:b8c41209-8b11-49e7-a8de-6e37a4d33c06, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) says merges need two approving reviews. The live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-18T03:33:52Z found branch main protected with 1 required review, applying to administrators. I wrote the draft from the live check so it doesn't claim more than is enforced today. The control owner should decide which is right: either set the requirement back to 2 reviews and update this answer, or correct the approved answer to 1. If the setting is put back to 2, run the check again before using the approved wording.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:b8c41209-8b11-49e7-a8de-6e37a4d33: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:df2d86b8-3aa4-47c8-8139-7b7facfe1: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:e12e5789-c53c-47a3-a1ec-a92b21326: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:697ef4f8-9b6d-4abb-b531-1d887e2db: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:a0aa0fba-a814-41e9-abcd-7124224c4: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:d12114ca-fd4e-429a-9faa-823ba98: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 1 approving review before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-18 03:33 UTC.
